source: DataForSEO keywords_data/google_ads/search_volume/live + dataforseo_labs/keyword_ideas/live + serp/google/organic PAA pulls, US, 2026-08-20
finding: Deep-chemistry exact-match terms (spray foam off ratio, spray foam chemistry, spray foam fire code, spray foam thermal drift, spray foam offgassing, closed cell spray foam problems) return NULL/zero volume — same pattern as prior CCA builds where jargon-precise terms have no direct search demand. Real, meaningful volume clusters on: (1) open-cell vs closed-cell comparison, (2) R-value/thermal performance, (3) safety/VOC concerns, (4) cost, (5) fiberglass comparison, and — the standout finding from live PAA data — (6) a large, current 'spray foam has a bad reputation' concern cluster (red flag, hard to sell house, insurance companies don't like it, people removing it, mold behind it). That reputation-risk cluster is NOT what a generic explainer site would lead with, but it is what real searchers are actually asking about right now, and it's the most defensible/differentiated angle for an authoritative science-education site backed by a former-contractor organization.
